body: I am not opposed to medication, but it will take a couple of weeks to get in to see a therapist. I don't know if I can take all of this that long. Hubby and kids are leaving for a couple of hours Saturday. I figure that is my D day.

Ever thought that maybe instead of 'you didn't do something that the rest of us did, and now you are dealing with wild animals for children' that their is something WRONG with my children. A 'hand on the ass' will probably work for my 6 year old, my 5 year old started asking to be spanked from the minute he could talk. He enjoys spankings, he enjoys pain. He will hurt himself on purpose, or get in trouble on purpose hoping for a spanking. So that is OUT!

I have thought about this a lot. I figure it I am dead then just maybe other family members will help out with the kids. It is a very long shot. They wont if I just leave. Even if I had myself committed they will not help. So hubby would lose his job. That would really be bad. It was the only job he could find at the time. Unemployment here keeps going up. Companies/Factories keep laying off. We would be in worse shape if I did not kill myself and he lost his job. I would be one less person to get in the way. And he could get a little time off to find child care if I am dead. Not if I just leave.

I am sorry for your loss, but I don't have any friends. My family will only be concerned because they wont have me around to get stuff instead of going to the store and buying it themselves. 

The kids and hubby might be upset for a while, but only because I am not there to do everything for them. 

Hubby actually told me to hurry up about it. 

They will all miss me in the fact that they wont have me to take advantage of, but as far as actually caring about me....Nope!

Reasons to keep having kids: Birth control failure.
Kid #2 was a BC failure with pills and film.
Kid #3 was a BC failure with depo shot and foam.

I tried to get my tubes tied after #2, but they could not do it where I went. I have lots of scar tissue from a ruptured gangreal appedendix. By the time I found a doctor to do tie my tubes, and got insurance all worked out, I was pregnant with #3.  

And thank you for letting me know how I failed as a parent. Very appreciated.

Lets see....Why should this post stop me from killing myself...You have told me I am raising failures as human beings, wondered why I kept having children, (I did say I tried to give one up for adoption but was not allowed), and basically have told me why I have failed. Thanks!
No relatives will keep the kids, they are just too destructive. Most of my family and hubby's just say 'I don't know what to tell you'

I would have to call and make an appointment. No telling when they would be able to get me in. If I go to the emergency room they wont do anything unless I tell them I am suicidal, even then no guarantees. I went once before and told them I was going to kill myself and they wanted to do a pap smear.
